text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While walking through town during
an outing with Inari One—
—Ah, it's Inari!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Yaaay! Inari, Inari~!
Great timing~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Running up to Inari One was Twin Turbo, her dorm roommate.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Well if it ain't Turbo!
What're you doing, coming around here
to play too?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: So, what did you mean by "good timing"?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Turbo went out to play,
but being alone is no fun!
And then Inari was right there!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Hey, I wanna play with Inari!
Play with me, play with me!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I see, so that's how it is.
Good grief, fine! Once you say something, you never back down anyway.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Boss. Sorry for springing this on you, but mind if
I go with this kid from here on out?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"Big Sis, sorry for the sudden ask, but do you mind
if I go with this one from here on out?"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Heheh, thanks for catching on so fast.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Yay! I get to play with Inari—!!
Let's go, let's go right now!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Dragged along by Twin Turbo,
we ended up at an arcade.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey!
Turbo wants to do that or that with Inari!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"I ain't really used to these kinds of games.
Since we're here, Boss, why don't you decide which one's better?"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"I ain't really used to these kinds of games.
Since we're here, Sis, why don't you decide which one's better?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Between the two games Twin Turbo wanted to play,
the one that looked more fun was—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, like a shooting gallery, right?
I feel like even I could do that—"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Wait, hey! Hold on!
Turbo, could that be...!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! The one where you shoot zombies!
Turbo looooves that one!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Guh...! That scary game where they swarm
all over the place...?! You sure picked a crazy one
right off the bat...!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Turbo is the strongest, so leave it to me!!
I'll protect you, Inari!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Haha... Well, ain't that reassuring...――

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
W-Why you little—get outta here!!
Don't come any closer! Take this! And that!!
T-There are way too many of 'em~~!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOOO----!
Turbo is the strooongest~!!
Take this, take this, take this, take thiiis~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Inari One and the other got fired up together
while enjoying an arcade shooting game—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
—*Haa*... *haa*...
That might've been more exhausting than an actual race...
Dammit all...—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! Inari was screaming the whole time,
it was so much fun!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Inari!
Let's do that next! That!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Haha, one after another, you guys are just full of energy.
Getting so hyped up like that—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"Because playing with Inari is so much fun!
Inari plays for real, so Turbo loves her!"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Inari~! Hurry, hurry~!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Man, she really is straightforward as they come...
I wonder if this is what having a little sister would feel like—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, while having fun playing with Twin Turbo,
I caught a fresh glimpse of Inari One's caring, nurturing side—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, so it's basically like trying to sink balls into each other's nets, huh...?
A serious one-on-one duel... sounds pretty damn interesting to me.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: “—Turbo! Since we're doing this, I won't hold back! You ready for this?”

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Hehe~n!
Turbo's the strongest, so I won't lose!
I'm gonna beat Inari to a pulp!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Bring it on!
Let's see what you've got!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOOO----!
Turbo Super Shooooot!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hah! Your trajectory is totally obvious!!
Alright, now it's my turn!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Not so fast!!
Turbo Hyper Guaaaard!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
H-Hey!?
Is dual-wielding even allowed!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Inari One and the others engaged
in a heated air hockey rally—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
—Sheesh, to think neither of us could score and we ended up in a 0-0 draw...!
Not bad at all, Turbo!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Not bad, Inari!!
You're almost as strong as Turbo!
I'll make you my rival!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Haha! Well, that's an honor!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Inari!
Let's do that next! That!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Haha, one after another, you guys are just full of energy.
Getting so hyped up like that—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"Because playing with Inari is so much fun!
Inari plays for real, so Turbo loves her!"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Inari~! Hurry, hurry~!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Man, she really is straightforward as they come...
I wonder if this is what it'd feel like if I had a little sister—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, while having fun playing with Twin Turbo,
I caught a fresh glimpse of Inari One's caring, nurturing side—
